messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — getting a bunch of customer reports about auth latency spikes. p99_auth_latency on the prod SLO dashboard jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s around 03:10 UTC.
ops-bot: ALERT: p99_auth_latency > 1s for prod (03:12 UTC) https://dash.redwood/prod/auth
Maria P: I pulled traces — lots of long auth spans with repeated 401 -> token refresh -> retry loops. Some requests hit auth-proxy and see a 500 then retry which adds ~1s.
Jamal R: Quick note on metrics: the SLO panel uses a 1m rollup + histogram buckets that floor to 10ms. If retries produce multiple spans per logical request, the p99 in the rollup panel will look worse than the raw trace-derived quantile.
Rebecca L: Repro steps from support/customer side (minimal):
```bash
# get token
curl -s -X POST https://auth.redwood/api/token -d '{"user":"test"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -o token.json
TOKEN=$(jq -r .token token.json)
# call service
curl -s -H "X-Auth-Token: $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -w "\nHTTP: %{http_code}  TIME: %{time_total}\n"
```
I see intermittent 500s from auth-proxy and subsequent retry latency ~900-1200ms.
Jordan (support): Customer says issue started immediately after the auth-proxy rollout at 02:55. They attached logs showing retries. Can SRE confirm rollout artifacts? We may need rollback or config tweak.
deploy-bot: deploy auth-proxy v2.1.3 -> prod @ 02:55 UTC by rebecca.l (canary 10%).
Alex K: Rolling back is an option but will impact canary progress. Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) Increase client-side retry backoff for auth calls to avoid hammering 2) Enable cached session tokens fallback in gateway for 30m 3) Add alert on retry_count_ratio > 0.05 so we don't conflate retries with true p99.
Jamal R: For observability action: add a panel that shows trace-derived p99 (histogram quantile from raw spans) and a separate 'retry events' series. That should resolve the dashboard-vs-trace dispute. Also verify that our rollup aggregation is not including duplicate spans per logical request.
ops-bot: ops action taken: triggered emergency rollback window check @ 03:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: initiated rollback auth-proxy v2.1.3 -> v2.1.2 (simulated) at 03:45 UTC.
Maria P: After rollback, p99_auth_latency trending down (03:58 UTC). Traces show fewer 500->retry cycles. I'll open a follow-up ticket to align histogram bucketing and add a trace-based quantile panel + annotation of deploys.
Alex K: Good catch. Jordan, please notify the affected customer about the rollback, offer a small credit, and ask them to retest. I'll own the metrics ticket to resolve the rollup/histogram mismatch permanently. :thumbsup:
thread_text: Auth latency spike, p99 discrepancy between rollup/histogram and traces; repro steps, rollback and mitigation discussed
